Every edge exists to flow.

Inspired by natural aerodynamics and Formula-grade airflow analysis, our silhouette isn't just beautiful—it's brutally effective. This is speed sculpted into form.

  • Active aerodynamics with auto-adjust rear spoiler
  • Low-drag coefficient body (Cd 0.28)

  • Dual-fin diffuser for optimal downforce

  • 14" Adaptive OLED Display with Gesture Control
  • Italian Nappa leather + Alcantara surfaces
  • Magnetic ride control from steering column
  • LED ambient lighting synced with driving mode
